conviction_note: The H1 numbers (adj. EBIT margin about (4)%, FCF EUR(1,248)m, net debt EUR1.1bn) and the cut FY26/27 guide were already published on 2 Nov, and Moody's negative outlook followed on 9 Nov, so the 17 Nov release mostly confirms known lines. What it can add is detail on the EUR2bn deleveraging plan (a rights issue is flagged by Deutsche Bank and Oddo). In the closest precedent (Oct 2023 pre-warning, then a Moody's negative outlook, then the H1 deleveraging plan on 15 Nov 2023) the stock fell 15.0%, but the May 2024 release that set out the rights issue rose 9.4%. A 6.8% disclosed short, built from 5.0% since the warning, adds squeeze fuel. Sign is near a coin flip (p_up 48). The size is large (7%) because this name's own results-day moves are large: 15.0, 9.4, 12.2, 17.3, 4.1 and 2.0%.

already_public.what: Preliminary H1 2026/27: orders EUR11.0bn (book-to-bill 1.2), sales EUR9.3bn (+3%, +2% organic), adj. EBIT margin about (4)%, FCF EUR(1,248)m, net debt EUR1.1bn at 30 Sep 2026, 1,860 cars produced

FY2026/27 guide cut: adj. EBIT margin about 1% (was about 6.5%, implying about 6.5% in H2), FCF EUR(1.5)bn (was 'positive'), organic sales growth low-to-mid single digit (was about 5%), cars about 4,000 (was 4,400-4,500), book-to-bill above 1 unchanged

Deleveraging objective of about EUR2bn by Sept 2027 through a 'review of all possible organic and inorganic options', with board-represented shareholders supportive; a new EUR2.0bn RCF was signed on 1 Nov 2026; a Capital Markets Day is set for Q2 calendar 2027
Moody's affirmed Baa3 and moved the outlook to negative
Broker resets: Citi to neutral (target 14), Deutsche Bank target 13 and a possible EUR1.5bn rights issue (19% dilution), JPMorgan to neutral (target 15.60)

new_in_release.expect: More detail on the EUR2bn deleveraging (sequencing, asset sales, whether a rights issue is chosen and whether CDPQ/Bpifrance commit). Unknown whether it comes on 17 Nov or with the early-2027 decisions. This is the line most likely to move the stock, and its sign is ambiguous.
Expected to be reiterated two weeks after the cut. The downside risk is softer wording on the implied 6.5% H2 adj. EBIT margin rebound.
Working-capital detail. The 2 Nov release says H1 FCF was helped by milestone payments and down payments pulled forward into H1, so H2 cash quality is the thing to watch. Mildly negative risk.
The exact adj. EBIT margin replaces 'around (4)%', plus net income after provisions and any impairment. Expected in line with the pre-release.
Alstom pays no interim dividend. No change expected.

bar: The company's own preliminary H1 figures and its cut FY2026/27 guide (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/11/FCMKW111158_20261102.pdf). No H1 consensus was found, but the pre-release makes the company statement the bar.
session_check: amc. Alstom's own IR page gives 'Nov 17, 2026 — 18:00 CET … 6.00 pm: Publication of press release, 6.30 pm: Live audiocast', which is after the 17:35 Paris close (https://www.alstom.com/fy-202627-half-year-results). The French page agrees: '18h00 : publication du communiqué de presse' (https://www.alstom.com/fr/ex-202627-resultats-semestriels). The 2 Nov release's financial calendar also lists '17 November 2026 FY 2026/27 Half-Year Results'. Last year's H1 went out at 17:00 UTC (18:00 Paris) on 2025-11-13 per the AMF flux. The window is therefore 17 Nov close to 18 Nov close.
positioning_check: The AMF positions courtes nettes register was read (covered: true, as of 2026-11-12, position date 2026-11-10). Disclosed net short is 6.81% across 10 sellers, against 5.94% ten days earlier and 4.99% with 6 sellers on 2026-10-28, before the warning. That is about 1.8 points and 4 new sellers added since the 2 Nov warning, so shorts are building into the print (baseline https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/c2539d1c-8531-4937-9cba-3bd8e9786cc5 and the stage's eu-short-cache history). Goldman Sachs International also crossed 5% individually on 2 Nov via an off-market acquisition (AMF filing 2026-11-12), which is consistent with stock-lending or hedging flow around the short build.

findings.finding: The EUR2bn deleveraging is still an open 'review of all possible organic and inorganic options' to be done by Sept 2027. Brokers flag a rights issue (Deutsche Bank: about EUR1.5bn, 19% dilution; Oddo: disposals, a capital increase or hybrids, possibly with the State taking part), and the closest precedent ran Oct 2023 pre-warning, then a Moody's negative outlook, then a deleveraging plan with the H1 results, and fell 15.0% on that H1 day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From the AMF flux plus Yahoo daily bars: 15 Nov 2023 H1 release (released 06:32 UTC) announcing deleveraging steps after the 4 Oct 2023 pre-warning and the 12 Oct 2023 Moody's negative outlook: -15.03%. 8 May 2024 FY release setting out the EUR1bn rights issue with CDPQ/Bpifrance support: +9.36%. A plan first announced this way has been sold, and a plan whose details remove uncertainty has been bought.
findings.original_quote: Ce plan inclura des mesures "organiques et non organiques", ce qui signifie simplement que la société n'exclut pas de passer par une augmentation de capital ou des cessions d'actifs pour renforcer son bilan. [...] "La participation de l'État à toute opération inorganique pourrait selon nous être envisagée", a ajouté le courtier. (Tradingsat, 2026-11-02, https://www.tradingsat.com/alstom-FR0010220475/actualites/alstom-le-groupe-s-attend-a-bruler-15-milliard-d-euros-de-cash-alstom-lance-un-nouvel-avertissement-sur-resultats-massif-et-s-effondre-de-28-en-bourse-1172909.html) In English: 'The plan will include organic and inorganic measures, which simply means the company does not rule out a capital increase or asset sales... State participation in any inorganic operation could be considered, the broker added.' Deutsche Bank, per Easybourse 2026-11-03: 'une potentielle augmentation de capital avec maintien du DPS' (a potential rights issue with preferential subscription rights).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock has drifted from 11.69 (2 Nov close) to about 10.04 with shorts building, which is what pricing an expected rights issue looks like. What is not priced is the form and timing: whether 17 Nov brings a committed rights issue (dilution certain, uncertainty removed, the May 2024 pattern) or only a continuing review (overhang kept). No source fixes which. The size is small because the sign depends on that choice and the negative case agrees with a building short.
findings.independence: Moody's negative outlook says credit metrics may stay outside Baa3, which raises the pressure to act: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/alstom-moody-s-abaisse-la-perspective-de-sa-note-de-stable-a-negative_705868. The DB rights-issue estimate is a separate broker view: https://www.easybourse.com/industrie/news/1540881/alstom-toujours-dans-rouge-analystes-manoeuvre.html

findings.finding: Disclosed net shorts rose from 4.99% (6 sellers, 28 Oct) to 6.81% (10 sellers, 10 Nov) after the warning, with the stock at a 2-year low after -37% in 20 sessions, so a reassuring release meets crowded, recently built short positions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 4 Oct 2023 warning the stock fell another 15% on the H1 day despite shorts. After the 17 Apr 2026 warning (-27.2%) the next session was +2.7%. After 2 Nov 2026 (-26.1%) there was no bounce: -4.8% and then drift. The 14 Nov 2024 amc H1 beat ran +12.2%.

If the market had already squeezed it there would be a bounce off the 2 Nov low, and the tape shows seven straight lower closes instead.

findings.finding: The cut guide still needs about a 6.5% adj. EBIT margin in H2 after about (4)% in H1, and the 2 Nov release says H1 FCF was flattered by milestone and down payments pulled forward into H1. So the 17 Nov H2 commentary and working-capital detail carry downside risk to an implied H2 that is already demanding.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance and cash lines have been decisive for this name: 14 May 2025 FY with weak FCF guidance -17.28%, 17 Apr 2026 FCF target withdrawn -27.15%, 2 Nov 2026 guide cut -26.09%. Reiterations moved little: 13 May 2026 +2.02%, 14 Nov 2025 +4.13%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the guide was cut two weeks ago and is expected to be reiterated, so this is sized toward zero. The unpriced part is whether management softens the H2 rebound wording. Moody's own text ('pourrait éprouver des difficultés à ramener ses principaux indicateurs de crédit', i.e. could struggle to bring its main credit metrics back) shows outsiders doubt the trajectory. If the market believed the H2 6.5% fully, the stock would not trade at about 0.25x sales.
findings.independence: Moody's 9 Nov: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/alstom-moody-s-abaisse-la-perspective-de-sa-note-de-stable-a-negative_705868. Citi on the 8-10% margin target being pushed to at least FY2031: https://www.easybourse.com/industrie/news/1540881/alstom-toujours-dans-rouge-analystes-manoeuvre.html

findings.finding: Commercial momentum held after the period: Q2 book-to-bill was 1.8, and after 30 Sep Alstom booked a roughly EUR800m first-tranche order in Vietnam (19 Oct) and a nearly EUR1bn Greater Anglia services extension (15 Oct). That supports the unchanged book-to-bill above 1 and the backlog quality management will stress on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Orders have not moved this stock on results days. Record orders at the FY25/26 results (13 May 2026) came with a +2.0% day, and the 2 Nov release carried a 1.2 book-to-bill alongside -26%.
findings.original_quote: Alstom remporte une première commande d'environ 800 millions d'euros au Vietnam (Alstom wins a first order of about EUR800 million in Vietnam)
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and priced, and the period is pre-released, so it is sized near zero. Orders are not the line in question.

outside_window.finding: Decisions from the organisational and operational review are due 'by early 2027', and a Capital Markets Day with the medium-term trajectory is set for Q2 calendar 2027. If the deleveraging specifics are pushed to then, the financing overhang lasts beyond this window.
Q3 2026/27 orders and sales on 19 January 2027.

searched_and_found_nothing: No published H1 2026/27 consensus. Alstom posted a company-compiled consensus PDF in 2024; none was found for this half, which is expected because the half was pre-released.
No press report between 3 and 16 Nov 2026 of a mandated rights issue, banks hired, a named asset sale or a CDPQ/Bpifrance commitment (English and French searches).
No new Coradia Max customer statement (DB Regio, SFBW and others) after 2 Nov beyond the 2 Nov coverage of delays to 2028.
Nothing in the AMF flux between 2 Nov and 16 Nov except the Goldman Sachs threshold crossing. Alstom filed no regulated release on the Moody's action this time, unlike 2023.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +3.1 (squeeze term) against a run-up of -37%. The findings net slightly negative (-0.2) because the financing question cuts against the lean, offset by the same crowded short, so they mostly cancel. The sign is near a coin flip, and the only strong statement is about size: this name's own results days have moved 2-17%.
language_note: Tradingsat (FR, 2 Nov) carried Oddo BHF's view that the State could take part in an inorganic operation ('La participation de l'État à toute opération inorganique pourrait selon nous être envisagée'), and its reading that 'organic and inorganic' means a capital increase is not ruled out. The English wires I read did not carry the State angle.

Easybourse (FR, 3 Nov) carried Deutsche Bank's explicit rights-issue estimate ('une potentielle augmentation de capital avec maintien du DPS', about EUR1.5bn, 19% dilution) and Citi's view that the 8-10% margin target slips to at least FY2031. The English results gave the downgrades but not the rights-issue sizing.

The AMF flux, in French, gave the Goldman Sachs 5% crossings (2 Nov up, 30 Sep down) and the 2023 analog's timeline with timestamps (4 Oct 2023 pre-warning, 12 Oct Moody's, 15 Nov H1 with deleveraging), which anchor the reaction history.
Alstom's French IR page confirmed '18h00 : publication du communiqué de presse', the same as the English page, so it added nothing new on the session.
lessons_applied: 'Positioning is the thing to beat' and 'a crowded short against a negative': the financing finding agrees with a building 6.8% short, so it went from -1.0 to -0.6 and p_up from 47 to 48.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the orders and backlog finding rests on public, pre-released data, so it went from +0.2 to +0.1.

'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error' and 'size on the name's own reaction distribution': abs_move_pct went from 6.5 to 7.0. Observed results-day moves for Alstom are 15.0, 9.4, 12.2, 17.3, 4.1 and 2.0%, against a pre-released base of about 3%.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': this kept the guidance and cash finding negative because of the pulled-forward H1 milestone payments. Its size was unchanged.
